requirement.description: Const class has improper error handling for layout validation. Tests expect specific error messages but get generic TypeError messages when validating layouts.
requirement.contract: When constructing a Const with an invalid layout (e.g., StructLayout object instead of a proper Layout), it should raise a TypeError with a specific error message matching expected patterns.

requirement.description: IOValue handling lacks proper validation for IOPort conversion and type checking. Tests fail due to TypeError when trying to convert IOPort to IO values.
requirement.contract: When constructing IO values with IOPort objects, the system should properly validate and convert them. Invalid objects should raise appropriate TypeError with descriptive messages.

requirement.description: IO port handling has insufficient validation for Direction combinations and type checking. Tests fail when validating Direction combinations and IO port conversions.
requirement.contract: When constructing IO ports with invalid directions or incompatible types, it should raise appropriate errors with descriptive messages. Direction combination should properly validate inputs.

requirement.description: IR building and netlist generation has issues with IO port transformation and fragment processing. Tests fail with TypeError when transforming IO ports.
requirement.contract: When building IR fragments with IO ports, the system should properly transform IO values and handle fragment preparation without raising TypeError for IO-port objects.

requirement.description: View class has incorrect error handling for attribute access and field validation. Tests fail due to incorrect error messages and missing validation for reserved names.
requirement.contract: When accessing non-existent attributes on Views, it should provide clear error messages listing available fields. When accessing reserved field names, it should raise specific AttributeErrors with appropriate messages.
